About

With over 28 years of experience, 1 Day Kitchen & Bath is the #1 source of kitchen or bathroom remodeling.  We offer over 200 colors of quartz, granite, marble, and limestone to choose from as well as a wide selection of both RTA cabinetry and custom cabinets. We offer excellent low prices on Quartz, Granite, Marble, Tile, Installation and Fabrication. Specializing in custom home installations both new and remodels. We offer our experience in design, material selection, and installation expertise to help you achieve the ultimate style in your home interior surfaces. So from your pool to your kitchen countertops we can offer you stone solutions to fit your many needs.

We have complete control over every phase of the process so our prices are very competitive.  Please visit our Portfolio and other pages for samples of some of our previous work.  Call or email us to get an free estimate.   Visit our new showroom in Los Angeles, CA (By Appointment Only).   We are also able to complete kitchen or bathrooms countertops in just 1 or 2 days.

"We chose Dominic and his crew to help rebuild our kitchen after a water leak. Dominic is knowledgeable, highly communicative, and patient/willing to answer lots of questions. The bid he provided was clear and competitive and he made sure to have an independent auditor review it to support our insurance claim. "I’m really glad I chose to work with Dominik and his team! I had unstable tiles on the back wall of my shower from a poor previous installation. I came in with a lot of concerns (and a budget), and Dominik genuinely listened and worked with me instead of pushing a full remodel. What stood out to me: - Dominik created a thoughtful 3-step quote that gave me options instead of pushing a one-size-fits-all solution, which no other contractor offered - Erik handled most of the work and was clear, responsive, and easy to communicate with - He was able to save and reuse many of my original tiles, which meant a lot to me since they’re no longer sold and I really didn’t want mismatched tiles - Erik even helped install my bathroom window screen, totally above and beyond! And something I didn’t expect at all... They had someone come in to clean not just the shower, but my entire bathroom. It was spotless. Overall, the whole process felt smooth and really well thought out. You can tell they care about both the quality of their work and their clients. Would definitely recommend Advanced Remodeling LLC :)"

QUICK ANSWERS

Cost, timeline, financing - answered.

The questions we get on almost every discovery call, with numbers, before you spend an hour on the phone.

How much does it cost to remodel in the greater Seattle area?

As a rule of thumb in the greater PNW: kitchens $45k - $95k for a pull-and-replace, $95k - $180k for a full gut. Bathrooms $12k - $22k for a half-bath, $22k - $45k for a hall/guest, $45k - $90k for a primary/en-suite. Whole-home cosmetic refreshes $60k - $150k; full interior renovations $180k - $450k. Every Advanced Remodeling quote is a written, fixed-price, line-item estimate.

Are you licensed and insured in Washington?

Yes. Advanced Remodeling LLC is a licensed WA general contractor - registration ADVANRL813RC - bonded and carrying $2 million liability insurance. We pull permits and coordinate inspections on every project that requires them.

How long does a remodel take?

Bathrooms: 3 - 6 weeks on site. Kitchens: 6 - 10 weeks on site. Whole-home cosmetic refreshes: 4 - 8 weeks. Full interior renovations: 12 - 20 weeks. Additions and ADUs: 5 - 8 months including design and permitting.

Do you offer financing?

Yes - remodel financing is available OAC (on approved credit) through our lending partners. Rates and terms depend on your credit profile and project size. Ask for a pre-qual during your free onsite consultation.

What areas do you serve?

We serve the greater Puget Sound / PNW area: Seattle, Bellevue, Kirkland, Redmond, Bothell, Mill Creek, Mukilteo, Everett, Lynnwood, Edmonds, Shoreline, Mountlake Terrace, and surrounding cities. Based in Mountlake Terrace, WA (98043).

How do I get started?

Book a free onsite consultation - no cost, no obligation. We walk your home, understand your vision, and put a written line-item scope and fixed-price estimate together before any work begins. Most projects are scheduled within 3 - 5 business days of contract signing.

AUTHORITY GUIDE · WHOLE-HOME & INTERIOR REMODELS

A whole-home remodel is a general-contractor problem, not a specialist one. Every Advanced Remodeling whole-home project runs under a single fixed-price contract, one project manager, and one warranty - kitchen, baths, floors, paint, siding, or an addition, we coordinate every trade in-house.

One team, one timeline, one contract

The failure mode on whole-home remodels is homeowners hiring 5 separate trades and playing dispatcher. We run every trade under our WA general contractor registration (ADVANRL813RC), on one signed contract, with weekly written updates. If something goes wrong, there's one number to call.

Planning and permits

Multi-room remodels almost always trigger permits - mechanical for HVAC changes, plumbing for kitchen/bath, electrical for panel upgrades, and building for any structural work. We handle drawings, submittal, inspections, and final sign-off. Additions and ADUs also require planning review and sometimes engineered drawings; we coordinate that upfront.

Live in or move out?

For a kitchen + one bath, most homeowners live in. For a full-floor remodel or anything with structural work, moving out for 3 - 8 weeks saves your sanity and shaves days off the schedule. We can zone the house with plastic and negative-air machines when you stay - and honestly tell you when moving out is the right call.

Additions, basements, and ADUs

Adding square footage is the highest-ROI move in a PNW market where lots are constrained. We build room additions, second-story pops, finished basements with egress, garage conversions, and detached ADUs. Every scope carries the same fixed-price contract and workmanship warranty as our finish work.

QUICK ANSWERS

Straight answers before you call

The questions we get most often on discovery calls - answered in plain English, with numbers, before you spend an hour on the phone.

How much does a whole-home remodel cost in Washington?

Whole-home cosmetic refreshes (paint, floors, trim, lighting, minor kitchen/bath updates) typically run $60,000 - $150,000. Full interior renovations touching kitchens, baths, flooring, and finishes across every room usually land $180,000 - $450,000. Additions and structural changes are quoted separately after a design consult.

How long does a full-home remodel take?

Cosmetic whole-home refreshes: 4 - 8 weeks. Full interior renovations: 12 - 20 weeks. Additions and ADUs: 5 - 8 months including design and permitting. Every project runs on a written schedule with weekly homeowner check-ins.

Should I move out during a whole-home remodel?

For gut-level renovations touching kitchens, primary bath, and HVAC - yes, usually 6 - 12 weeks. For phased or single-floor projects we can stage the work so you stay in the home. We plan the phasing at estimate time so there are no surprises.

Can you do additions and ADUs?

Yes. As a licensed WA general contractor we handle room additions, bump-outs, second-story additions, garage conversions, and detached/attached ADUs (DADU/AADU) from design and permitting through final inspection.

REMODEL ANSWERS

People also ask about full-home remodel

Real questions from the greater PNW homeowners - answered by a licensed WA contractor.

ELECTRICAL · LIGHT FIXTURES

Can a remodel install a light fixture in Washington State?

In Washington, only licensed electrical contractors and certified electricians may perform electrical work for hire - including swapping a light fixture. A remodel without an electrical specialty license legally cannot. Advanced Remodeling coordinates a licensed electrician for any hardwired work.

PLUMBING · LEAKS & WATER DAMAGE

How do I find a hidden water leak in my house?

Turn off every fixture and appliance, then watch the small red "leak indicator" dial on your water meter for 10 - 15 minutes. If it moves, you have flow somewhere with everything off - that's a leak. Isolate by shutting off the main to the house and the water heater; the meter tells you if it's on the incoming side or inside.

DOORS & WINDOWS · LOCKS & HARDWARE

How do I fix a door that won't latch properly?

A door that won't latch either has a strike plate that's out of alignment (most common) or the door itself has sagged. Close the door slowly and mark where the latch hits the strike - if it's above or below the hole, either move the strike plate or shim the top hinge to lift the latch side back into place.

EXTERIOR & WEATHERPROOFING · GUTTERS & DOWNSPOUTS

How often should I clean gutters in the Pacific Northwest?

Twice a year minimum - once in late fall after the leaves drop (mid-November) and once in spring (late March). Homes surrounded by Douglas fir, cedar, or big-leaf maple need a third mid-fall cleaning, typically late October. Skipping cleanings is the #1 cause of preventable siding and foundation damage we see.

INTERIOR REPAIRS · DRYWALL

How do I fix a drywall hole around a ceiling fixture?

For a hole smaller than the new fixture's canopy, no repair needed - the canopy covers it. For larger holes, cut a clean square around the damage, screw in a wood backer strip, patch with a drywall piece, tape the seams, and mud and sand in two coats. Ceilings need extra care because texture matching is the hardest part of the job.

APPLIANCES & FIXTURES · DISHWASHER & DISPOSAL

Can a remodel install a dishwasher in Washington?

Yes - a remodel can install a like-for-like dishwasher replacement: pull the old unit, disconnect the water supply and drain, slide the new unit in, and reconnect. What we can't do without a licensed electrician: hardwire a new circuit or upgrade the receptacle. Almost all replacements reuse the existing power connection, so this rarely comes up.

Full-Home Remodel FAQs
How long does a whole-home remodel actually take?

A cosmetic multi-room refresh runs 6 - 10 weeks. A kitchen + 2 baths + flooring is typically 12 - 20 weeks. Structural work or an addition pushes to 6 - 9 months including design and permitting. We commit exact dates in the contract with milestone payments tied to them.

Do you handle architectural drawings and permits?

Yes. For scopes without structural changes, we handle in-house drawings and permit submittal. For additions, ADUs, or load-bearing changes, we coordinate with a licensed architect or structural engineer and manage the full permit process end-to-end.

Can I phase the project?

Yes, and we recommend it for larger budgets. Common phasing: baths first (fastest ROI, least disruption), then kitchen, then flooring/paint, then exterior. Each phase is its own fixed-price contract, but the overall design is planned as one system so nothing is redone.

How much does full-home remodel cost?

Every full-home remodel project is priced with a written, line-item estimate - labor, materials, permits, and disposal broken out. Fixed price locked in a signed contract. Ranges depend on scope, materials, and finish level; consultations are free.

Do I need a design consultation first?

For anything beyond a straightforward install we start with a free onsite consultation. We walk your home, discuss scope and materials, and prepare a written estimate you can decide on with no obligation.

How do you handle change orders?

Any change to scope, materials, or finishes is documented in a written change order signed by both parties before that work proceeds. You always know the price before we start.

What areas do you cover for this?

From Marysville down through Snohomish County, across the Eastside to Bellevue, and over to Seattle - including Marysville, Everett, Mukilteo, Mill Creek, Lynnwood, Edmonds, Mountlake Terrace, Shoreline, Bothell, Kirkland, Bellevue, Redmond, Mercer Island, and Seattle. See the Service Areas page for the full list.

Is full-home remodel covered by your warranty?

Yes. We back all workmanship for 12 months on projects we perform directly. Materials and appliances are covered by their manufacturer warranty.

FAQs on Arcis Kitchen & Bath’s 10-Day Kitchen Remodels
What exactly is a 10-day kitchen remodel by Arcis Kitchen & Bath?

Our 10-day remodel is a highly streamlined process focused on efficiency and precision. We complete all essential updates to refresh and transform your kitchen within 10 days from the start of demolition.

What can I expect from a 10-day kitchen remodel?

You can expect a full cosmetic upgrade—cabinet refacing or replacement options, new countertops, updated fixtures, backsplash, flooring, and more. We elevate both the look and functionality of your kitchen in a fraction of the usual time.

How is Arcis Kitchen & Bath able to complete a remodel in just 10 days?

Through detailed pre-planning, a dedicated installation team, and well-coordinated processes, we streamline every step. All materials are ordered and confirmed before project start, allowing us to deliver a fast yet high-quality renovation.

Will the quality of work be compromised due to the fast timeline?

Not at all. Speed never comes at the expense of craftsmanship. Our efficient workflows and experienced installers ensure the same high-quality finish you’d expect from a traditional remodel—just faster.

Are there limitations on what can be done in a 10-day remodel?

A 10-day remodel is not a downgrade in quality. We use the same high-end products and finishes. The reason the timeline is short is because we avoid major construction—no moving walls, plumbing lines, or electrical layouts.

Structural changes or full redesigns require more time and city inspections, which extend the schedule.

What steps should I take to prepare for a 10-day remodel?

To keep the process smooth:

Clear out the kitchen and surrounding areas

Arrange temporary meal options

Finalize all design decisions, materials, and approvals before the start date

The more prepared you are, the more seamless the remodel.

Are permits required for a 10-day kitchen remodel with Arcis Kitchen & Bath?

Permits depend on the scope of work. Cosmetic “remove-and-replace” remodels may not require permits, but anything involving plumbing, electrical, or structural changes will. If needed, our team handles the entire permit process.

Can I make design changes during the 10-day remodel?

We strongly recommend finalizing all design decisions beforehand. Changes during installation may delay the project and extend it beyond the 10-day window. The design phase is critical to maintaining the schedule.

What happens if unexpected issues arise during the remodel?

Our experienced team is trained to handle surprises quickly and efficiently. We address any issues with minimal impact to the timeline whenever possible.

How do I get started with Arcis Kitchen & Bath for a 10-day remodel?

Contact us for a free consultation! We'll review your goals, evaluate your space, and guide you through the process to achieve a beautifully transformed kitchen in just 10 days.

Whether you're changing the layout, removing walls, relocating plumbing or electrical, or incorporating unique features, our team brings your vision to life with precision, creativity, and top-tier craftsmanship.

Every custom kitchen begins with a thoughtful design phase where we collaborate closely with you to understand your style, needs, and goals. From modern open-concept layouts to highly detailed luxury builds, we handle every aspect—from structural work and permits to installation and finishes—ensuring a seamless, high-quality renovation experience tailored to your home.

FAQs on Arcis Kitchen & Bath’s Custom Kitchen Remodels
What is a custom kitchen remodel?

A custom kitchen remodel is a full renovation that gives you complete flexibility to change the layout, move walls, update plumbing and electrical, and design every element to fit your lifestyle and aesthetic. It’s a completely personalized transformation built around your vision.

What can I expect during a custom kitchen remodel?

Expect a detailed design process, expert craftsmanship, and a fully tailored renovation. This may include layout changes, removing or adding walls, relocating appliances, custom cabinetry, upgraded plumbing and electrical, high-end finishes, and premium materials—resulting in a truly unique kitchen.

How long does a custom kitchen remodel take?

Timelines vary depending on the level of customization and structural changes. Once designs are approved and materials are selected, we provide a clear project schedule outlining demolition, inspections, installation, and finishing stages.

Do custom kitchen remodels require permits?

Yes. Any project involving plumbing, electrical, structural changes, or layout modifications typically requires permits. Arcis Kitchen & Bath fully manages the permitting process with your local municipality to ensure compliance and smooth progress.

Can I change the design during the project?

Design changes are possible but may affect both the cost and timeline. Because custom remodels are more complex, we recommend finalizing all selections and structural decisions early in the design phase to prevent delays.

Will I need to move out during the remodel?

Most clients remain at home during the renovation, but you may need to adjust your daily routine. We set up protective barriers, limit dust, and maintain a clean work environment. For major structural changes, temporary adjustments may be needed.

What happens if unexpected issues are discovered?

During structural or older-home renovations, unforeseen conditions such as outdated wiring, plumbing issues, or hidden damage can arise. Our team addresses these issues promptly, communicates clearly, and updates you on any scope adjustments needed.

What’s the first step to starting a custom kitchen remodel?

Begin with a design consultation. We’ll review your ideas, explore layout possibilities, discuss materials and features, take measurements, and guide you through the planning phase so your custom kitchen is perfectly tailored to your home.

Who We Are

Quality furnishings, superior installation, and excellent customer service make Benicia Home Improvement Center, Inc. you one stop shop for all of your remodeling needs. We are a full service showroom that appeals to professionals and homeowners throughout the Bay Area,  including Solano and Contra Costa Counties.

Our field installers,  designers, and showroom staff work together to share the knowledge that  we have accumulated after 25 years of being in the business with our clients, so that they can make informed decisions about the products  they decide to have installed in their homes. Customer service is our  number one priority, and we will work tirelessly to make sure that our  clients are more than satisfied. A large portion of our business comes from repeat customers, a testament to the quality of the work that we do. We have cultivated a reputation as professional problem solvers, and  are noted for doing the job right from start to finish.

We offer design services with every estimate. This covers in-home measurements and consultation, initial design and pricing, and a design review appointment with a design specialist at our showroom,  including three dimensional renderings of the new design and an initial  estimate review.

In our showroom, you will find comprehensive displays that will help you visualize what you want your space to look  like. We carry semi-custom and custom cabinetry, countertop materials  including granite, quartz, porcelain, tile for flooring and  backsplashes, custom closets, sinks, faucets, bathtubs, toilets, knobs,  and more. While we are a project based company, we also specialize in  retail sales. Regardless of whether you need a full bath remodel, or  simply a toilet, we would be more than happy to help. 

Come to our  showroom and see us in action! We will be happy to help you solve your  remodeling challenges, answer any questions you might have, meet with  your own contractor or coordinate and complete your remodel from start  to finish. When the job is done, we’ll even clean up the mess – leaving  you with a spotless space, ready to enjoy for the years to come.

Our Story: Built on Advocacy, Crafted for Longevity

Arcadia was born from a desire for a fresh start, not just for us, but for the homeowners we serve. We saw a clear gap in the remodeling industry: homeowners were left navigating unreliable contractors, unclear expectations, and poor communication. After experiencing these challenges ourselves, we set out to build something different. We built a company where integrity, transparency, and service come first.

Founded in 2022 as a family-run business, Arcadia Renovations started by helping homeowners rebuild after unexpected losses. In the insurance restoration world, we earned our reputation the hard way: mastering scope writing, negotiating with carriers, and advocating until our clients received the full value they were owed. That work taught us how to manage complex projects under pressure, keep every trade accountable, and communicate clearly with families living through the most stressful moment their home has ever seen.

It also taught us something else. Of every room we rebuilt, none changed how a family felt about their home more than the bathroom. It's the first room you see each morning and the last one at night, and when it's done right, it changes the whole rhythm of the house. So we made a decision most contractors won't: instead of doing everything, we chose to do one thing exceptionally well. Today, Arcadia Renovations is focused on designing and building beautiful, timeless bathrooms across Metro Atlanta and North Georgia, while our reconstruction team continues to manage full-scope insurance claims from roof to foundation with the same precision that built our name.

Every project, whether a spa-worthy primary bath or a complete rebuild after a loss, is guided by the same promise: exceptional craftsmanship, clear communication, and a process you can actually trust.

Better mornings start here … We'd be honored to build yours.

The Faces Behind Arcadia

Arcadia is more than a company, it’s a family. Led by a team with over two decades of combined experience in construction, design, and project management, our work is built on shared values: trust, excellence, and care for the people we serve.

Each member of our team brings a personal commitment to doing things the right way - with honesty, respect, and attention to detail that our clients can feel in every finished space. We’re proud to be a family-built company with a culture rooted in accountability, creativity, and the simple belief that every home we touch should reflect pride, both yours and ours.

When you work with Arcadia, you’re not just hiring a contractor, you’re partnering with a team that treats your home as if it were their own.

Ericksson Perez

Owner | Operations Manager

After nearly 14 years in corporate America, Ericksson Perez took a leap of faith into the remodeling world; a move that would ultimately inspire the creation of Arcadia. Early on, he recognized a troubling pattern in the industry: a lack of transparency, integrity, and genuine care for homeowners. Determined to change that narrative, he set out to build a company that homeowners could confidently recommend, knowing they’d be treated with honesty, respect, and professionalism.

Ericksson leads with a hands-on approach, working closely with his team and trade partners to ensure every project reflects a promise of "white-glove" professionalism. Guided by his extensive corporate background, he believes that true success is measured by impact rather than just profit. As a proud Latino, he is dedicated to serving his community and providing mentorship and opportunities for those around him, believing that a leader's duty is to lift others up and do the right thing even when no one is watching.

Beyond the business, Ericksson’s motivation is rooted in his family. Based in Acworth, he and his wife Carolyn are focused on building a legacy their daughter, Amara, can be proud of. Whether they are exploring the local foodie scene, attending fall festivals, or traveling to ensure Amara experiences a world of diversity and inclusion, family drives every decision he makes. Ericksson’s vision for Arcadia is simple: to redefine the standard of a general contractor and to be the elite remodeling and roofing firm that homeowners in North Georgia know they can implicitly trust.

Scott Molyneaux

Sales Manager

Scott Molyneaux joined Arcadia to lead our team with the same transparency and integrity the company was founded on. His partnership with Ericksson began in 2016, where they built a foundation of mutual respect while navigating the high standards of corporate leadership. Over the years, that relationship has evolved into a shared vision for redefining the contractor experience through honesty, advocacy, and a commitment to being a man of his word.

With a sharp business acumen and a direct, results-driven personality, Scott spent years excelling at the highest levels of the corporate world. As a General Manager for Verizon Wireless, he was a President’s Cabinet winner, an honor reserved for the top 1 percent of leaders company-wide. He later transitioned into a Business Account Manager role where he consistently led his team to top-tier performance. After mastering the home improvement industry and spending time in a national role with Focus 360, Scott now brings that same elite-level precision and pride in his work to Arcadia, ensuring every project is managed with corporate-grade discipline and a personal touch.

Beyond the business, Scott’s motivation is rooted in his family. Based in Gainesville, he and his wife are dedicated to raising their three children, Alexis, Jacob, and Maddie. Whether they are spending time on the lake with their two dogs or traveling to create new memories, Scott believes family is the heart of every home. He is committed to protecting his clients’ investments with the same passion and respect he gives his own.

Dan Smith

Business Development Manager

As the face of our B2B division, Dan Smith brings a rare level of local insight and leadership to Arcadia as our Business Development Manager. A true Atlanta native, Dan grew up in the very neighborhoods we serve today, including Dunwoody, Alpharetta, and Cumming. This lifelong connection to North Georgia gives him a unique perspective on the needs of our homeowners, allowing him to lead with a neighborly approach that is rooted in genuine care for his community.

Dan joined the team after spending over 20 years in leadership roles within the wireless industry, where he mastered the art of managing complex operations while keeping people at the center of every decision. At Arcadia, he applies that extensive leadership background to ensure our roofing sales team operates with radical transparency and professionalism. Working alongside our inspection team, Dan focuses on creating a seamless, "white-glove" experience that begins with the very first consultation, ensuring that every client feels heard, respected, and fully informed.

Beyond his professional life, Dan is a dedicated father to three boys and an active member of his community. His motivation is simple: he loves people and wants to ensure his neighbors have access to home services they can actually trust. Whether he is spending time with his sons or engaging with local families, Dan leads with the same integrity and "people-first" mentality that defines the Arcadia brand. He is driven by the opportunity to protect the homes in the community that raised him, delivering quality work built on a foundation of long-term relationships.

Scott McLelland

Senior Project Manager

Scott McLelland leads our restoration division with a level of empathy and precision that comes from a "scenic path" through the hospitality and business consulting worlds. A proud Georgia Southern Eagle, Scott found his true calling later in life, realizing that his diverse career background provided the perfect foundation for helping people when they need it most. Since 2023, he has worked closely with Ericksson, specializing in the complex world of property insurance claims. Scott doesn’t just manage projects; he advocates for homeowners, ensuring they have a dedicated partner to help put their homes and their lives back together after an unexpected loss.

Known for his radical transparency and a commitment to over-communication, Scott is an expert at navigating the fine details of restoration while keeping his clients educated and at ease. He believes that the most important part of any rebuild is the trust earned during the process. When he isn't advocating for our clients, Scott is a true family man who views his immediate and extended family as his entire world. Married for nearly 20 years and the father of two daughters, he has spent the last decade as a dedicated "sports dad" on the sidelines of competitive games.

With one daughter heading to college and the other getting her license, he is embracing a new season of life in Woodstock with his wife, Alexa, and their two dogs. Whether he is out on his motorcycle, hitting the golf course, or making memories around the firepit, Scott’s motivation is rooted in the same care he brings to every home we restore. He is a firm believer that doing the right thing for a family in a crisis is the highest form of service.

Savannah Ashlyn Sheriff

Designer | Creative Partner

Savannah brings to Arcadia a lifetime passion for design - a passion shaped from childhood, inspired by watching her father transform raw spaces into warm, intentional homes. Today, as founder and principal designer of Savannah Ashlyn Interiors, she merges timeless elegance, soulful detail, and personal storytelling to create interiors that feel both luxurious and deeply lived-in.

Working side-by-side with Arcadia’s remodeling team, Savannah handles everything from architectural drawings and design planning to material selections, moodboards, and full-scale interior direction. Her job? To ensure that when the hammers stop swinging and the dust settles - the space you step into is not only beautifully built, but thoughtfully composed, artfully finished, and unmistakably yours.

When you choose Arcadia + Savannah Ashlyn Interiors, you’re not just getting a contractor and a designer, you’re getting a unified team committed to excellence, clarity, and a white-glove process built around your vision.

FROM SMALL BEGINNINGS

Matthew and Hannah Collins started the business in August 2016 with a simple approach: work hard, treat people right and trust God with the outcome. There were no investors or large crews. Just a commitment to doing quality work and earning the next referral.

What began with wood rot repairs and door installations grew into kitchen, bathroom and whole-home remodeling. The work changed in scale. The values behind it stayed the same.

Matthew’s service in the United States Army shaped the way he leads: discipline, accountability, respect and follow-through. He coordinates the crew, suppliers, subcontractors and schedule from the first conversation to the final details.

Family remains at the center of the business. Hannah homeschools their children while supporting hiring, culture and the company’s direction behind the scenes. Matthew and Hannah make the major decisions together.

At Cornerstone Kitchen & Bath, we are a locally owned and family operated kitchen and bath company located in Raleigh, North Carolina. Our services expand beyond this simple label to include new cabinetry for your current home or new home construction, as well as home offices, laundry rooms, entertainment centers, and many other functional areas.

As opposed to some other retailers, Cornerstone Kitchen & Bath offers a more comprehensive approach to updating a kitchen or bathroom. From the initial consultation to the design work with 3D renderings, the installation, and the follow-up service calls, you’ll find our team equipped to provide personalized, dedicated, expert services. We use our own skilled labor for all our work, including new cabinet installation or cabinet refacing.

In many ways, the skill used to install a kitchen is as important (if not more so) than the cabinets themselves. Having our own employees involved in the installation process allows us to take full ownership of each project and provide you, our valued customer, with dependable quality results from one source of accountability.

We understand that trust is an obstacle to overcome when dealing with any contractor. At Cornerstone Kitchen & Bath, we have been serving the Triangle since 1983, and it is no coincidence that we have extraordinarily high levels of customer satisfaction. Displaying the highest levels of integrity with our customers is the only means to sustain the longevity that we have enjoyed for over 35 years.

A significant portion of our new business is through word of mouth referrals, and that means we remain dedicated to providing an exceptional product at fair prices with unparalleled customer service. We have hundreds of customers who will attest to this fact.

Please contact us today to discuss your upcoming kitchen or bath remodeling project in the Raleigh area. We look forward to serving you!

Learn About Criner Remodeling
Yorktown Remodeling Contractor Serving Yorktown, Newport News, Poquoson, and Hampton.

Since 1977, Criner Remodeling has been your local Yorktown remodeling contractor. We offer kitchen remodeling, bath remodeling, sunrooms, and additions to the areas of Yorktown, York County, Hampton, and Newport News.

Kitchen Remodeling – A lot of our Yorktown remodeling contractor work comes from kitchen remodel projects. Kitchens are really the heart of the home and because of this, it is so important to have a kitchen that is both functional and beautiful. If your kitchen is more than 10 years old, it might be time to think about a remodel. Kitchens from the past don’t always work well for today’s families. Families today tend to need more space, double ovens, and an intuitive layout. No matter what is preventing you from loving your kitchen (form or function), Criner Remodeling can help. With over 45 years of kitchen remodeling experience, they can walk you through the process of getting your kitchen updated to be the kitchen of your dreams.

Bath Remodeling – Bathroom remodeling is one of the most requested home remodeling projects that we see. Styles and needs change over the years, causing homeowners to take a second look at their bathrooms. As with kitchens, if your bathroom is over 10 years old, it might be time to take another look at it. Materials don’t last forever so you might have chipped, rusting, or deteriorating aspects that you want to get rid of. We work with each homeowner to discuss their needs, wants, and dreams. We want you to be able to use your new bathroom for a long time so we want to make sure that we do it right.

Regardless of the remodeling project at hand, we strive to offer fantastic customer service, excellent craftsmanship, and quality products. We want our homeowners to walk away feeling like family and enjoying their newly remodeled space for years to come with friends and family.

We are proud to hold the highest designations of any other local contractor, including:

Graduate Master Remodeler
Graduate Master Builder
Certified Aging In Place Specialist
Certified Green Professional

Frequently Asked Questions:
Do you give free estimates?

We provide a free initial consult, which usually includes a basic “ballpark” figure for your scope of work. After the free initial consult, our design process includes 3D computer modeling, written design specifications, and a price for the scope of work. We do charge for the design process. However, this fee is waived if you sign a construction agreement.

Do you do small jobs or repair work?
We focus on full replacement bathrooms, kitchens, and additions. We are not set up for small jobs or repair work.
Do you work in my area?
We focus our efforts on the Virginia Peninsula, including Newport News, York County, Poquoson, Hampton, Williamsburg, and parts of James City County.
When can you start?
We can start on the planning process immediately. However, the time it takes to plan a project well, secure permits, and assemble quality materials usually prevents us from being able to start immediately. We are not set up for emergency work.
Can you meet me in the evening or on the weekend?
We are a family-oriented company so we schedule our meetings during business hours on weekdays. We can usually meet you as early as 8:00 AM or as late as 4:00 PM, Monday through Friday.
How long does a typical project take?

Every project is different, so it’s hard to provide an estimated time-frame. However, once your project begins, we will be there M-F every day until your project is complete. We do not leave you hanging to go to other jobs. You get a Criner employee on site every day from start to finish. You’ll have peace of mind knowing that we will work hard until everything is completed and will whole-heartedly dedicate ourselves to you and your project.

Built on Experience. Driven by Detail.

Freedom Kitchens & Baths specializes in full kitchen and bathroom remodels across Central New Jersey.

With 8+ years of renovation experience, we focus on delivering clean, well-planned renovations with clear communication, reliable timelines, and strong attention to detail.

By specializing in full remodels, we're able to provide a more organized process, fewer surprises, and a finished space that looks right and functions properly.

LAKESIDE KITCHEN DESIGN: YOUR PREMIER KITCHEN AND BATH SHOWROOM IN PENN YAN, NY

Lakeside Kitchen Design continues its legacy of excellence in kitchen, bath, and home remodeling design and installation services throughout the Finger Lakes region. While under new ownership, we’re proud to build upon the strong foundation established since 1989.

Our fresh, innovative design team is dedicated to helping you create inviting kitchens and bathrooms tailored to your unique needs and lifestyle. We offer personalized design services, an extensive selection of cabinet lines, and superior product installation.

At Lakeside Kitchen Design, we understand the intricate details involved in kitchen and bathroom remodeling. Our expert design services, combined with a commitment to quality and customer satisfaction, ensure that your vision becomes reality.

Under new leadership, we’re excited to blend time-honored craftsmanship with modern design trends, offering you the best of both worlds. Visit our showroom and experience the perfect mix of established expertise and fresh perspectives in home renovation.

A FEW WORDS ABOUT LAKESIDE KITCHEN DESIGN

Lakeside Kitchen Design is a premier kitchen and bath showroom located in Penn Yan, New York, serving the Finger Lakes region since 1989. Recently, the business was acquired by new owners Luke and Kerry Catlin, who are committed to upholding the company’s legacy of excellence while ushering in a new era of innovation and customer-centric service.

Luke Catlin, the new owner, brings over 8 years of experience in remodeling and design. His background in construction, problem-solving, and attention to detail ensures that every project under Lakeside Kitchen Design is completed with the utmost precision and efficiency. Luke’s diverse skillset allows him to tackle any challenge that arises, from custom cabinetry installation to full-scale kitchen and bathroom renovations.

Kerry Catlin, Luke’s wife and business partner, handles the financial and administrative aspects of Lakeside Kitchen Design. With over 7 years of bookkeeping experience, Kerry’s expertise in financial management and attention to detail ensures the smooth operation of the business. As a current college student pursuing a degree in Human Services, Kerry’s dedication to continuous learning and growth aligns with the company’s commitment to providing exceptional customer service.

Luke and Kerry are passionate about cultivating a strong sense of community around Lakeside Kitchen Design. They are excited to build upon the company’s legacy of total customer satisfaction by offering personalized design services, a wide selection of high-quality cabinets and products, and superior installation services. Whether working with homeowners directly or collaborating with contractors, the Lakeside team is dedicated to exceeding the expectations of every client.

Experience the Lakeside Difference At Lakeside Kitchen Design, the friendly and professional atmosphere in the showroom will put you at ease during the design and selection process. From initial consultation to final installation, the Lakeside team is committed to guiding you through every step of your kitchen or bathroom remodeling project. Visit our showroom or explore our website to see why discerning homeowners in the Finger Lakes region choose Lakeside Kitchen Design for their remodeling needs.

Planning a Kitchen Remodel in Canandaigua, NY: What Lake-Area Homeowners Should Know
Lakeside Kitchen Design
October 9, 2026
Estimated reading time: 4 minutes read
 
 
 
 

A kitchen remodel in Canandaigua, NY starts with one question: how does your household actually use the room? Year-round homes near Canandaigua Lake, weekend cottages and older houses in the city each need a different plan.

Lakeside Kitchen Design has designed and installed kitchens across the Finger Lakes since 1989, working from our showroom at 2486 State Route 54A in Penn Yan. Canandaigua, Victor, Naples, Honeoye, Gorham and the rest of Ontario County are all part of our regular service area.

This guide covers what Canandaigua homeowners ask us most: cost, timing, layout, countertops and storage.

Gray shaker cabinets, a charcoal island and wood floating shelves in a Canandaigua kitchen we remodeled

Start With How the Kitchen Gets Used

Before we talk about cabinet colors, we ask who cooks, who gathers and where guests end up standing.

A lake home that fills up every summer weekend needs a big island and clear walkways. A year-round family kitchen needs pantry storage and a work zone that keeps the cook out of the traffic path.

The Canandaigua kitchen above solved both: a charcoal island with seating for three, an apron-front sink under the window and open shelving that keeps everyday dishes in reach.

How the Kitchen Is Used	Layout Priority	Design Detail That Helps
Weekend lake house with guests	Large island, wide aisles	Seating on the island, durable quartz top
Year-round family kitchen	Storage and a protected work zone	Tall pantry cabinets, deep drawers
Smaller cottage or older home	Making every inch work	Floating shelves, cabinets to the ceiling
What a Kitchen Remodel Costs in the Canandaigua Area

Cost depends on how much of the room changes. Upgrading cabinets and countertops in the same layout costs far less than moving plumbing, electrical and walls.

For simple remodels that replace cabinets or countertops, homeowners can expect to spend around $25,000. Extensive remodels that include electrical, plumbing, framing and drywall work can reach $100,000 or more.

Cabinets are usually the largest part of the budget. Plan roughly 5% of your budget for fixtures such as the sink and faucet.

Project Scope	Typical Investment	What Usually Changes
Cabinet and countertop refresh	Around $25,000	Cabinets, countertops, hardware, fixtures
Full remodel in the same layout	Between the two ranges	Cabinets, counters, lighting, flooring coordination
Full remodel with layout changes	$100,000 or more	Plumbing, electrical, framing, drywall and finishes

We put pricing in writing with 100% transparent pricing and no hidden fees, so the number you approve is the number you pay.

How Long a Kitchen Remodel Takes

Cabinets drive the schedule. It can take 6 to 8 weeks before new cabinets arrive and are installed, and a remodel that changes plumbing, electrical, framing and drywall can take up to 12 weeks.

Lake-area homeowners often time the work around the season. Many Canandaigua clients plan a remodel for the months the house is used least, so the kitchen is finished before summer guests arrive.

Choosing Countertops for a Finger Lakes Kitchen

We offer granite, quartz, solid surface and plastic laminate countertops. Each one fits a different budget and way of cooking.

Countertop	Strengths	Good to Know
Granite	Scratch, heat and chemical resistant	Natural stone, every slab is different
Quartz	Very hard, non-porous, easy to clean	Not heat-resistant, use trivets for hot pans
Solid surface	Seamless look, integrated sink options	Minor scratches can be buffed out
Plastic laminate	Most budget-friendly, many patterns	Best kept away from direct heat

Granite is about 100% stone, while quartz is roughly 95% stone and 5% polymer resins. We recommend choosing by how the surface looks and fits your kitchen. Our granite vs. quartz guide goes deeper.

The same Canandaigua kitchen: white quartz island with seating, stainless appliances and shiplap walls

Storage Beyond the Kitchen: Mudrooms and Built-Ins

In the Finger Lakes, the kitchen often connects to a side entry that takes the brunt of boots, coats, beach bags and snow gear.

On this Canandaigua project, we built a mudroom with a bench, drawers below, hooks above and tall storage cabinets. It keeps the clutter out of the new kitchen.

We build custom cabinets for any room, including mudrooms, laundry rooms, entertainment centers and built-in desks.

Custom mudroom built-ins with a bench, drawers and tall storage cabinets in a Canandaigua home

Why Canandaigua Homeowners Work With Our Penn Yan Showroom
One team from design through installation, with licensed plumbers and electricians for that part of the work
A showroom where you can see cabinet lines and countertop samples in person
A+ BBB rating, accredited since 2001
A 4.7-star rating from 39 Google reviews
A 1-year workmanship warranty, plus manufacturer warranties on the products we install

Learn more about our kitchen remodeling services and custom built-ins.

FAQs
Do you remodel kitchens in Canandaigua and the rest of Ontario County?

Yes. We regularly work in Canandaigua, Victor, Naples, Honeoye, Gorham, Clifton Springs, Shortsville and Manchester, along with Penn Yan and the rest of Yates County.

How much does a kitchen remodel cost in Canandaigua, NY?

Simple remodels that upgrade cabinets or countertops run around $25,000. Extensive remodels with electrical, plumbing, framing and drywall work can reach $100,000 or more.

How long does a kitchen remodel take?

It can take 6 to 8 weeks before cabinets are installed, and a remodel with plumbing, electrical and framing changes can take up to 12 weeks.

Can I see cabinets and countertops before I decide?

Yes. Our Penn Yan showroom at 2486 State Route 54A displays cabinet lines and countertop samples so you can compare them in person.

Do you install appliances and flooring?

We install the appliances you choose and coordinate their delivery. We do not sell flooring, but we work with local flooring stores and schedule their work around ours.

Maison Vue was born out of a shared passion for transforming homes into beautiful, functional spaces. We’re Heather and Ken, the founders, of Maison Vue Home. How the “Project 6 Days: Bathroom Redefined” Method Works

Our exclusive 6-day method is designed for homeowners who need a fast, organized, and high-quality bathroom renovation with minimal disruption. Here’s how it works:

#Step 01

Planning & Material Selection – Before the project begins, we schedule detailed meetings to define every aspect of your new bathroom. We help you choose tile design, toilet, vanity, niches, shower valves and finishes, drain style, color palette, and all other details. Having all materials selected and ready on-site ensures a smooth, uninterrupted schedule.

#Step 02

 Day 1 – Demolition & Subfloor Prep – We remove the old fixtures and materials, making necessary adjustments to the subfloor and preparing niches for your new layout.

#Step 03

 Day 2 – Plumbing & Waterproofing – We install or adjust plumbing lines, set the new shower valve, and fully waterproof the shower area, preparing it for tile installation.

#Step 04

Day 3 – Flooring Installation – Both the shower floor and main bathroom floor are installed with precision and proper leveling.

#Step 05

Days 4 & 5 – Walls, Niches & Tile Finishes – We build your shower walls, install niches, and complete all tile work for a sleek, elegant look.

#Step 06

Day 6 – Final Fixtures & Details – We install the shower trim, valves, toilet, vanity, and any remaining accessories, ensuring every detail is finished to perfection.

WHY CHOOSE DESIGN-BUILD?

Design-build combines both design and construction in one easy process. Here's why it's the best choice for your renovation:

One Team for Everything: No need to juggle different designers and contractors. You'll work with one team that takes care of everything.

Teamwork from Start to Finish: Our designers and builders work closely to ensure your vision comes to life exactly as you imagine.

Quick, Clear Communication: With design and construction on the same team, decisions are faster, and the process runs smoothly.

Additional bedrooms for a growing family

How We Handle Your Second-Story Addition Project in Westchester County?

A second-story addition is a bigger structural undertaking than most renovations, and it calls for careful coordination from day one.

Initial Planning

Permit Assistance

Second-story additions typically require more extensive permitting and structural review than other extensions. We manage that process so you don't have to navigate it on your own.

Construction & Integration

We match rooflines, siding, and exterior details so the new level blends seamlessly with the original home, not as a separate addition sitting on top of it.

Completion

We stay through the final walkthrough, making sure the new floor is finished properly and ready for your household to use.

SEA Design Build Process
Concept To Completion: A Seamless Home Remodeling Process In The Bay Area

At SEA Design & Build, our Bay Area design-build process is built around you. Every remodel whether a kitchen remodel, bathroom remodel, ADU, or full home renovation — is personalized to fit your lifestyle and vision. With a dedicated project manager overseeing each step, we handle design, permits, and construction to keep your project running smoothly, on time, and to the highest standards.

1.
Phone Consultation

Every project begins with a friendly phone consultation. We’ll discuss your goals, budget, and timeline to determine how our design-build approach can bring your vision to life. This first step helps us understand your needs and answer initial questions about the remodeling process.

2.
In Home Meeting

Next, we visit your home to evaluate the space in person. This allows us to learn more about your style, and explore potential solutions. Our team listens carefully to ensure your remodel fits your lifestyle and enhances your home’s value.

3.
Concept & Feasibility Study

We create a clear concept and assess the feasibility of your project. From layouts to structural requirements, we provide practical solutions that align with your budget and goals. This stage sets the foundation for a stress-free remodeling journey.

4.
Design & Materials Selection

Our designers collaborate with you to bring your ideas to life. Together, we choose finishes, fixtures, and materials that match your taste and budget. With expert guidance, you’ll see your remodel take shape with a personalised design plan.

5.
Planning & Permitting

We handle all the details, including architectural plans, engineering, and city permitting. By managing these steps for you, we ensure your project complies with local codes and is ready for smooth construction.

6.
Construction

With everything approved, our skilled team begins construction. Your dedicated project manager keeps the remodel on track and communicates with you at every stage. The result is a beautifully finished space, delivered on time and to the highest standards.

What Cleveland Homeowners Should Know Before Remodeling an Older Bathroom

Older homes throughout Cleveland and Northeast Ohio have incredible character, craftsmanship, and history. From Cleveland Heights and Lakewood to West Park, Tremont, and Hudson, many homeowners are drawn to original architecture, solid construction, and established neighborhoods.

But when it comes to bathroom remodeling, older homes often come with hidden challenges behind the walls, beneath the floors, and inside outdated plumbing and electrical systems.

At Spot-On Home Improvements, we’ve remodeled bathrooms in homes that are 50, 80, and even 100+ years old throughout Cleveland and Akron. While these homes can produce beautiful finished bathrooms, older remodeling projects require careful planning, local experience, and realistic expectations before demolition begins.

If you’re considering remodeling an older bathroom in Northeast Ohio, here are the biggest things homeowners should know before starting.

1. Older Plumbing Systems Can Create Major Surprises

One of the biggest unknowns in older bathroom remodeling projects is plumbing.

Many older Cleveland homes still contain:

galvanized water lines
cast iron drain stacks
outdated shut-off valves
aging vent systems
corroded fittings

Even bathrooms that appear functional on the surface may have hidden plumbing deterioration behind walls or beneath floors.

Once demolition begins, contractors often uncover:

slow leaks
pipe corrosion
water damage
improper past repairs
outdated drain configurations

Homes throughout Lakewood, Cleveland Heights, and older Cleveland neighborhoods commonly require plumbing updates during remodeling projects.

The American Society of Home Inspectors recommends homeowners carefully evaluate aging plumbing systems before major renovations begin.

2. Uneven Floors and Settling Are Extremely Common

Many older homes have settled over decades.

As a result, bathroom floors are often:

uneven
sloped
sagging
layered with multiple generations of flooring (MULTIPLE!)

This becomes especially noticeable during tile installation.

In some homes, simply removing old flooring reveals:

damaged subfloors
weakened joists
previous water damage
structural movement

Proper preparation matters tremendously before installing:

tile
luxury vinyl flooring
heated floors
curbless showers

Ignoring floor preparation can lead to:

cracked grout
loose tile
squeaking
long-term movement issues
3. Old Electrical Systems Often Need Upgrades

Bathroom electrical requirements today are dramatically different than they were decades ago.

Many older homes were not designed for:

LED lighting
Exhaust fans
GFCI outlets
Electric mirrors
Electric bidets
Modern vanity lighting
Heated Floors

Older bathrooms may contain:

undersized wiring
overloaded circuits
ungrounded outlets
outdated electrical panels
or Hidden Wiring

Modern bathroom remodeling frequently requires:

dedicated circuits
upgraded wiring
additional lighting
improved switch placement
updated code compliance

The National Electrical Code Overview provides modern electrical safety standards that many older homes no longer meet.

4. Moisture Damage Is Often Hidden Behind Walls

Bathrooms naturally create moisture, and older homes often lacked the waterproofing systems used today.

During demolition, it is common to uncover:

mold
rotted framing
deteriorated drywall
soft subfloors
failing shower surrounds
improperly vented exhaust systems

This is especially common in bathrooms that have been repeatedly patched over the years instead of fully renovated.

At Spot-On Home Improvements, we frequently recommend complete waterproofing upgrades using modern systems designed to better protect the home long term.

Resources like This Old House Bathroom Remodeling provide additional insight into proper moisture management during bathroom renovations.

5. Layout Limitations Require Creative Solutions

Older bathrooms were often designed much smaller than modern homeowners prefer.

Common issues include:

tight toilet clearances
narrow doorways
limited vanity space
poor lighting placement
awkward layouts
insufficient storage

In many older Cleveland homes, homeowners want:

larger showers
double vanities
better lighting
more open layouts

Achieving those goals sometimes requires:

moving plumbing
relocating walls
reframing layouts
improving ventilation
redesigning storage

This is where experienced planning becomes critical.

6. Permits and Code Updates Matter More in Older Homes

Many older homes have experienced decades of:

DIY repairs
Partial remodels
Outdated workmanship
Non-permitted work

Once a remodel begins, contractors may discover:

Unsafe wiring
Improper plumbing
Framing modifications
Ventilation issues
Outdated installations

Professional remodeling helps ensure projects are brought closer to modern standards while protecting both safety and long-term resale value.

According to the National Kitchen & Bath Association, professional planning and code compliance remain some of the most important factors in successful bathroom renovations.

Remodeling Older Bathrooms Requires Local Experience

Bathroom remodeling in older Northeast Ohio homes is different from remodeling newer suburban construction.

Homes throughout:

Cleveland Heights
Lakewood
West Park
Tremont
Ohio City
Hudson
Rocky River

all come with unique structural and architectural characteristics.

Older homes often require:

problem-solving
flexible planning
hidden repair allowances
careful demolition
modernization without losing character

Bathroom Remodeling Mistakes Cleveland Homeowners Should Avoid
Common Bathroom Remodeling Mistakes in Northeast Ohio

Bathroom remodeling can dramatically improve the comfort, appearance, and value of a home — but only if it is planned correctly.

As both a remodeling contractor and real estate professional serving Cleveland, Akron, Independence, Lakewood, Westlake, Hudson, and surrounding Northeast Ohio communities, I’ve seen homeowners spend thousands of dollars on bathroom renovations that either:

fail prematurely,
create future maintenance problems,
hurt resale value,
or simply don’t function well for daily life.

The truth is that bathroom remodeling is one of the most detail-sensitive projects in a home. Small decisions involving layout, waterproofing, lighting, ventilation, and materials can create major long-term consequences.

Here are the bathroom remodeling mistakes I see most often throughout Northeast Ohio — and how to avoid them.

1. Choosing Cheap Waterproofing Systems

This is one of the biggest mistakes homeowners make.

Beautiful tile means absolutely nothing if the shower system underneath it fails.

Many contractors still use outdated methods or improperly install waterproofing materials, which can eventually lead to:

mold growth,
water damage,
loose tile,
wood rot,
or leaks into lower levels.

At Spot-On Home Improvements, we strongly emphasize proper shower preparation and waterproofing because the structure behind the tile matters more than the tile itself.

According to the National Kitchen & Bath Association (NKBA), moisture management is one of the most critical elements of long-lasting bathroom remodeling.

Homeowners throughout Cleveland and Akron should prioritize:

waterproof shower systems,
proper sloping,
quality drain installation,
and vapor/moisture protection.

A properly built shower should last decades — not just until the warranty expires.

2. Ignoring Bathroom Ventilation

Northeast Ohio winters create significant humidity and moisture challenges inside homes.

One undersized or improperly vented bathroom fan can quietly destroy:

drywall,
paint,
trim,
and even attic spaces over time.

This is especially common in older homes throughout:

Lakewood
Cleveland Heights
Parma
Shaker Heights

Many older bathrooms were never designed for modern shower usage or enclosed steam-heavy environments.

The U.S. Department of Energy Ventilation Guide also highlights the importance of proper household ventilation for moisture control and air quality.

Adding:

stronger vent fans,
timer switches,
humidity-sensing fans,
or secondary ventilation

can dramatically improve the longevity of a bathroom remodel.

3. Installing Trendy Materials That Age Poorly

Social media has created a wave of “Pinterest bathrooms” that look great online but age quickly in real life.

In Northeast Ohio, homeowners should think carefully before selecting:

ultra-trendy colors,
unusual tile patterns,
low-quality gold fixtures,
or highly personalized designs.

As a realtor, I regularly walk homes where buyers immediately begin mentally budgeting for removing recent “designer” bathrooms because they already feel dated.

Timeless bathrooms typically outperform trendy bathrooms long term.

That doesn’t mean boring.

It means choosing:

balanced lighting,
durable materials,
clean tile selections,
quality vanities,
and layouts that function well for everyday life.

Current bathroom trends are moving toward wellness-focused spaces, wet rooms, accessibility improvements, layered lighting, and spa-like functionality. According to Houzz’s 2025 Bathroom Trends Report, homeowners are increasingly prioritizing comfort, functionality, and long-term usability over purely decorative upgrades.

4. Overspending Where Buyers Don’t Care

This is where being both a contractor and realtor becomes valuable.

Not every dollar spent in a bathroom returns value.

In many Northeast Ohio neighborhoods, buyers care more about:

cleanliness,
layout,
lighting,
storage,
and shower quality

than they do about ultra-high-end imported materials.

For example:

A smart walk-in shower upgrade may dramatically improve value.
Spending thousands extra on unique imported tile may not.

According to Remodeling Magazine Cost vs Value Report, bathroom remodel ROI depends heavily on keeping renovations aligned with neighborhood expectations.

A bathroom in:

Hudson
may justify different selections than one in:
Parma Heights

That’s why remodeling strategy matters.

5. Poor Bathroom Lighting Design

Lighting is one of the most overlooked parts of bathroom remodeling.

Many bathrooms rely on:

one overhead light,
poor mirror lighting,
or outdated yellow lighting tones.

A well-designed bathroom should include layered lighting such as:

vanity lighting,
shower lighting,
ambient lighting,
and task lighting.

Modern lighting upgrades can make a bathroom feel:

larger,
cleaner,
brighter,
and significantly more luxurious.

This is especially impactful in smaller bathrooms common throughout older Cleveland-area homes.

6. Choosing the Wrong Contractor

Bathroom remodeling is highly specialized.

Tile layout, waterproofing, plumbing coordination, ventilation, framing, and finish carpentry all need to work together correctly.

Unfortunately, many homeowners select contractors based only on:

lowest price,
fastest timeline,
or flashy social media photos.

That often becomes expensive later.

When hiring a bathroom remodeling contractor in Cleveland or Akron, homeowners should verify:

local experience,
real project photos,
reviews,
communication,
licensing/insurance,
and detailed scopes of work.

At Spot-On Home Improvements, we focus heavily on communication, craftsmanship, layout planning, and long-term functionality because bathroom remodeling is about more than appearances.

Bathroom Remodeling Trends We’re Seeing in Northeast Ohio

Some of the most requested bathroom upgrades we’re seeing throughout:

Independence
Westlake
Rocky River
Macedonia

include:

walk-in showers,
floating vanities,
bench seating,
large-format tile,
matte black fixtures,
backlit mirrors,
curbless shower entries,
and improved storage solutions.

Many homeowners are also prioritizing aging-in-place features that improve accessibility without sacrificing style.

Thoughts On My Way Out

A successful bathroom remodel is not just about making a bathroom look better.

It’s about:

durability,
functionality,
resale value,
comfort,
and smart long-term planning.

The best bathroom remodels balance:

aesthetics,
practicality,
and neighborhood value expectations.

For homeowners throughout Cleveland, Akron, and Northeast Ohio, avoiding these common mistakes can save thousands of dollars and create a bathroom that performs beautifully for years.

Tiannuo Construction is a locally operated California licensed general contractor based in Jurupa Valley, serving homeowners throughout Riverside County and Orange County. Founded in Southern California, our company was created to provide homeowners with reliable, high-quality construction services without the confusion and stress often associated with remodeling projects. From the first consultation to final completion, we focus on honest guidance, realistic timelines, and workmanship that stands the test of time.

Our team specializes in kitchen and bathroom remodeling, ADUs, garage conversions, and full home renovations. Every project is carefully planned, code-compliant, and executed with attention to detail — ensuring your investment adds lasting comfort, functionality, and property value.

As a licensed and insured general contractor, we take pride in building long-term relationships with our clients through transparency, professionalism, and consistent results. Treasure Valley Redesign and Remodel is a locally owned and operated full-service remodeling contractor committed to building and renovating great homes and commercial spaces for our clients. We know that home is your domain, your sanctuary, where you'll raise your kids, host your grandkids for holidays, build a life, build a family. Let us sit with you and dream about how to turn your house into the dream home you've always wanted.

Our company specializes in many remodeling projects. Our kitchen remodeling service will make your kitchen more beautiful and functional with a new layout and design. We can also redesign your bathroom and make it one of the nicest places in your home. If you want home additions, we also have your back. Our home additions and extensions service will help you expand or add a new area that will incorporate the existing style and design of your house.
